featured_reviews.name: brendan fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Shanti Book Store. When I went to buy books, they offered used books, claiming they were “unused,” and sold them at a discounted price. Later, when I took my daughter’s old books to sell, they offered me only ₹100. After that, I noticed the same books were being sold to other parents at a much higher price (around half of the MRP).
This feels unfair and misleading. I request that other parents be careful while buying or selling books here. The old man who handles it is a very cheap beggar. When I said that I am taking my old books back then he took out some books giving them back to me and says this is no longer in use school has stopped this edition and u feel that it is not in use. This is all about a scam. Parents be alert.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Chadha
featured_reviews.review_text: They host wonderful events, but even more importantly, the staff are an absolute pleasure. I was looking for a book by a particular author and, after some disappointing experiences at another popular bookshop in Bandra, I was genuinely nervous about asking for help. At that other store (which rhymes with “confectionery”), the staff were often rude and surprisingly unfamiliar with many authors. When I cautiously approached the desk, the two gentlemen working there were incredibly kind, helpful, and immediately knew exactly who I was talking about. Their warmth and knowledge made all the difference. On top of that, they have a fantastic selection of books and authors. A truly lovely bookstore.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai Book Centre – A Trusted Hub for Academic Books in Kurla East

Mumbai Book Centre in Kurla East is a go-to destination for students and professionals seeking academic resources. The store offers a vast collection of books catering to various educational levels and fields, including:
•	NCERT textbooks for school students
•	Undergraduate and postgraduate materials for BA, BSc, and other degree courses
•	Engineering and diploma textbooks
•	Competitive exam preparation guides

One of the standout features of this bookstore is its affordability. Customers can avail themselves of discounts ranging from 10% to 40% (on notebooks, long books& A4 long books), making it a budget-friendly option for acquiring essential study materials.

The staff at Mumbai Book Centre are known for their helpfulness and knowledge, assisting patrons in finding the exact books they need. Whether you’re looking for the latest editions or specific publications, their team is ready to help.

Located conveniently in Kurla East, the store is easily accessible for residents and students in the area. Its comprehensive inventory and customer-friendly approach make it a reliable choice for academic book shopping.

featured_reviews.name: Sheldon Dias
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located in the St. Pauls Media Complex, St Paul Book And Art Centre Mumbai is a serene landmark that serves as a one-stop destination for spiritual literature and religious artifacts. It is particularly well-regarded for its peaceful, library-like atmosphere, offering a quiet refuge for visitors to browse through a wide range of specialized materials.
• Diverse Collection: The store is a major hub for religious and spiritual books, including Bibles in various editions, theological texts, and Catholic literature, as well as academic titles, CBSE textbooks, and children's storybooks.
• Art and Gifts: Beyond literature, it features an extensive selection of religious artifacts, such as statues, rosaries, candles, and framed prints, making it a popular spot for meaningful gifts and church supplies.
• Holiday Highlights: During the Christmas season, the first floor transforms into a festive destination stocked with unique décor, souvenirs, and seasonal ornaments.
• Supportive Environment: Visitors frequently mention the well-organized layout and the helpful, professional staff who are knowledgeable about the inventory and assist with niche title requests.
